title: The Country That Never Learned Its Name

features.name: unnamed-border
features.desc-on-touch: An archway marking the place where arrival becomes departure. You pass through it and forget which direction you were facing.

features.name: unmappable-territory
features.desc-on-touch: The country ripples under every attempt to draw its borders. The map and the land are learning to disagree.

features.name: threshold-between-arrival-and-leaving
features.desc-on-touch: A tower made of the moment between stepping in and stepping out. Time glitches here. You're never quite sure which way you came.

features.name: country-learning-to-speak
features.desc-on-touch: A glyph of the shape the country makes when it tries to say its own name. The characters keep rearranging.

features.name: routes-that-refuse-ending
features.desc-on-touch: Paths scatter through the country, each one leading somewhere that turns out to be where it started. The archive cannot find the way out.

inscription: every country learns its name from the outside—but this one exists only at the threshold, refusing to be either arrival or departure

file.name: Territory_Unnamed_Field_Notes_Final_Entry.txt
file.note: The surveyor's last record: 'The country keeps moving. Today it is where yesterday it was not. I have stopped trying to map it.'

exits.label: deeper into unmapped country, where names go to die
toward the boundaries that refuse their own meaning
